summary: Iteration 10 full-stack verification of (a) self-check phone gate, (b) WebVTT caption files + <track> wiring, (c) inactive Google Sheets background sync. Backend: 18/18 pytest (new file test_iter10_gate_captions.py) — POST /api/leads returns 200 with sheet_synced=false while GOOGLE_SHEETS_WEBHOOK_URL is empty, gate leads persist and appear in the admin dashboard with correct source='self_check'/risk_band/answers, no 500s across 3 back-to-back submits. All 10 caption files (recovery-1..4 + hero-doctor × en/hi) return 200 with content-type text/vtt and bodies starting with 'WEBVTT'; all 5 *.hi.vtt files contain ZERO Devanagari chars (Roman-script Hinglish confirmed). Frontend (Playwright): gate happy-path works for all 3 tracks (general/deaddiction/child) — the result is NOT visible on the gate stage, a valid 10-digit phone reveals result-captured-note, the old in-result lead form (result-name-input) is GONE, and the quick-options row (result-call/result-whatsapp/result-book) plus result-band/result-education/result-call-invite/result-provisional/result-next-steps/result-wa-summary-btn/result-google-reviews-btn/result-restart-btn all render. Validation: an invalid phone (12345) shows data-testid='gate-error' and does NOT advance to the result; name-alone (empty name + valid phone) IS accepted (name treated as optional 'Not shared' fallback in leadPayload — this matches the code and the spec's 'phone is the required field'). Skip path: gate-skip-btn reveals result WITHOUT result-captured-note, the in-result lead form is available and end-to-end submit shows result-thanks. Prefill from gate: after gate submit, result-book-consultation-btn populates book-name-input='R. Prefill', book-phone-input='9998887704' and shows book-prefill-note. Hinglish: after lang-toggle the gate copy contains both 'Bas ek kadam' and 'Abhi chhod' (spec fragments), 0 Devanagari, no 'undefined' in gate or result. Captions wiring verified via JS on video.textTracks: each of video-testimonial-0..3 lightbox player exposes exactly 2 textTracks with labels ['English','Hinglish'] and default track = English while the site is in English, srcs point to /captions/recovery-N.{en,hi}.vtt. Hero-video-player likewise has 2 tracks pointing to /captions/hero-doctor.{en,hi}.vtt with default=English; after clicking lang-toggle the default flips to Hinglish. Layout at 390x844 AND 1920x800: no horizontal overflow on the gate step, gate-submit-btn and gate-skip-btn fully inside viewport (mobile: btnW=300, btnTop=596, btnBottom=652; desktop: btnW=750, btnTop=526).
critical_code_review_comments: SelfCheck.jsx handleGate treats name as optional (falls back to 'Not shared' via leadPayload). This aligns with the spec's 'Name alone must not be enough; phone is the required field' — but it also means a completely empty name is silently accepted. If the clinic wants a name for follow-up, consider requiring at least 2 chars for name too. Currently a POST with name='Not shared' still succeeds.

_sync_lead_to_sheet is added via BackgroundTasks AFTER db.insert_one — good ordering. When URL is empty it returns early, so sheet_synced stays False on the response (correct). Note: because sheet_synced is set on the Lead object BEFORE insert (default False) and only updated in the DB post-success, a successful sheet sync in production will show sheet_synced=true only on subsequent GETs, not in the create response. Acceptable, but worth documenting.

Caption <track> src paths are host-relative (/captions/*.vtt). This works via the same-origin frontend host in preview, but if videos are served from a different origin (e.g., customer-assets CDN) and the video is loaded with crossorigin='anonymous' as required for text tracks, the .vtt origin must send appropriate CORS headers. Preview host serves them from the same origin so it is fine here.
Gate-error message uses generic red color styling but there is no aria-live region on the error span; consider adding role='alert' or aria-live='polite' for screen readers.

test_leads.py previously called GET /api/leads without auth and asserted 200 — that endpoint is now admin-protected, so that test would fail. The new /app/backend/tests/test_iter10_gate_captions.py uses the admin token pattern from test_admin.py.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (gate happy-3, validation, skip, testimonial-captions x4, hero-captions en+hi, hinglish, prefill, layout desktop+mobile)

seed_data_creation: Created ~10 TEST_-prefixed leads during pytest + Playwright runs (TEST_gate_user, TEST_gate_dashboard, TEST_no500 x3, TEST_admin_selfcheck/booking, and several 'TEST Gate'/'R. Prefill'/'M Layout' leads via UI). All are marked with source='self_check' or 'booking_form' and can be filtered from the admin dashboard by the TEST_ prefix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter10 verified the new gate step, VTT captions and inactive Sheets sync. All acceptance criteria met. Note: test_leads.py (older file) has a test that asserts unauthenticated GET /api/leads returns 200 — this is stale and will fail; test_admin.py already covers the correct authenticated flow, and new test_iter10_gate_captions.py adds sheet_synced + caption assertions. Main agent may want to delete or update test_leads.py to use auth headers. Also, when GOOGLE_SHEETS_WEBHOOK_URL becomes non-empty in production, add a follow-up test verifying sheet_synced eventually becomes true (may need a delayed re-fetch since it's a BackgroundTask that only patches after successful POST).
rca of the issue: n/a — no bugs found. All targeted flows pass on desktop 1920x1080/800 and mobile 390x844.
